effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault, and the vault supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints shares (steakUSDCinfinifi) to `receiver`; the share count comes from the stored share price, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', with the USDC amount, a fixed share ticker 'infinifiUSDC' and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit shows share ticker 'infinifiUSDC', but the vault token's symbol is 'steakUSDCinfinifi'.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "infinifiUSDC"; meta.json constructor __symbol = "steakUSDCinfinifi", __name = "Steakhouse infiniFi USDC"; case 0 mined share transfer symbol 'steakUSDCinfinifi' to the signer.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "steakUSDCinfinifi". This matches the token the signer sees in the wallet.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the signer receives; the count comes from the stored share price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor); case 0: the signer receives 0.194412176932051226 steakUSDCinfinifi, and no field shows the amount.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset or say that vault shares come back.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for vault shares" and add an interpolatedIntent: "Deposit {assets} for shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The 0.2 USDC out is shown correctly. The shares in go to the right address, but no amount is shown and the ticker differs from the on-chain symbol.

effects: The vault takes USDC from the signer. The amount comes from the stored share price (rounded up), and nothing caps it.
The vault mints exactly `shares` vault shares to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', with deposit asset 'USDC' (no amount), the minted share amount, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show the USDC amount taken from the signer; the stored share price sets it, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), ...). Case 1: 0.000001 USDC leaves the signer, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that USDC leaves the signer's wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent "Mint"; in case 1 the reader was unsure how much USDC is deposited.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint vault shares".

findings.title: mint shows minted shares as 'infinifiUSDC', but the token symbol is 'steakUSDCinfinifi'.
findings.evidence: case 1 screen 'Minted shares: 0.000000001 infinifiUSDC'; meta.json __symbol "steakUSDCinfinifi"; vaultTicker constant "infinifiUSDC".
findings.fix: Use the on-chain symbol steakUSDCinfinifi in the constants.

cases.notes: The USDC out has the right asset and direction, but no amount is shown. The shares go to 0xdead, not to the signer, and the screen shows this correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns `owner`'s shares. The count comes from the stored share price (rounded up). When the caller is not the owner, the call spends the caller's share allowance.
The vault withdraws exactly `assets` USDC from Morpho and sends it to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', with 'Withdraw exactly' and the USDC amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many vault shares it burns from the owner; the stored share price sets the count.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil); case 2: 1921.78 steakUSDCinfinifi leave the signer, and no field shows this.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not say that vault shares are burned to pay out USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw intent "Withdraw"; in case 2 the reader thought nothing leaves the wallet.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Burn vault shares to withdraw USDC" and add an interpolatedIntent naming {assets} and {receiver}.

cases.notes: The 2000 USDC in is shown correctly. The reader sensed that the position goes down, but did not see that vault shares leave the wallet or how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`. When the caller is not the owner, the call spends the caller's share allowance.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount comes from the stored share price (rounded down), and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', with the share amount (ticker infinifiUSDC), the receiver and the owner. Nothing names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only. Case 3: the signer receives 4024.022221 USDC, and the reader wrote 'probably USDC'.
findings.fix: Add {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, as in the mint format, and change the intent to "Redeem vault shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the stored share price sets it, and there is no minimum.
redeem shows the shares as 'infinifiUSDC', but the token symbol is 'steakUSDCinfinifi'.
findings.evidence: case 3 screen '3932.011361770664429975 infinifiUSDC'; mined symbol steakUSDCinfinifi.
findings.fix: Use the on-chain symbol in the constants.
